title: What is the common problem with coffee machines?
desc: Common problems include clogged water lines, malfunctioning pumps, heating element failures, or issues with the brewing cycle. These problems often arise from lack of regular cleaning or mineral buildup.

title: Can coffee machines be fixed?
desc: Yes, most coffee machines can be repaired depending on the issue. Simple problems like water not flowing or the machine not heating can often be fixed quickly. More complicated issues might require professional service.
